This was a deliberately small, self-contained artefact-creation task with no dependencies on prior work, so no broader context was needed beyond the session's own working directory. Capturing work artefacts like this matters because it turns ephemeral agent activity into durable, inspectable evidence: a file on disk can be re-read, diffed, audited, and referenced by future sessions long after the conversation that produced it is gone. That verifiability underpins trustworthy handoffs between agents and operators — claims of completion become checkable facts rather than assertions, and the accumulated artefacts form a breadcrumb trail that lets any future session reconstruct what was done, when, and why, without relying on memory or trust alone.
